about: The organisations the daily routine works from. Core organisations are checked thoroughly on every run: their known pages, plus a search of their whole website for anything on AI and cyber. Hints are places to look each run, without a guaranteed check. The routine changes these lists only by fixed rules: Rule 1 promotes an organisation to core if it is a UK government body or national AI safety or security institute with a stated AI security remit, or has published 3 or more News items in the last 90 days; Rule 2 moves a core organisation to hints after 180 days with nothing relevant, unless it is marked fixed. Pages found on a core organisation's own website are added automatically. Every change is logged in data/sources.json changes.
